review_locator: PMCID:PMC3680630, E-selectin ligands as mechanosensitive receptors on neutrophils in health and disease; PMCID:PMC11294169, E-selectin in vascular pathophysiology
primary_title: L-selectin from human, but not from mouse neutrophils binds directly to E-selectin
decision_basis: The reviews identify human L-selectin as an E-selectin ligand, and the cited primary study demonstrates direct human L-selectin-E-selectin binding, sialidase/calcium dependence, antibody inhibition, and E-selectin-supported rolling under flow.
limitations_preserved: Preserve human-neutrophil specificity: mouse neutrophil L-selectin does not show the same E-selectin ligand behavior; retain glycosylation, purified-protein, and shear-flow context; no generic selectin cross-reactivity or SCI inference.

review_locator: DOI:10.1016/j.smim.2024.101900, The role of sialoglycans in modulating dendritic cell function and tumour immunity
primary_title: A functional glycoproteomics approach identifies CD13 as a novel E-selectin ligand in breast cancer
decision_basis: The review identifies sLeX-decorated CD13 among additional E-selectin ligands and cites the primary breast-cancer glycoproteomics study; the primary study isolates E-selectin-binding glycoproteins and validates CD13 glycoforms as sLeX-bearing E-selectin ligands.
limitations_preserved: Preserve CD13 and CD44 co-expression, sLeX glycoform, patient-derived breast-cancer context, and affinity/proximity validation limits; no standalone CD13 intracellular relay or SCI inference.
